> **Smart detection of project type, build tools, test frameworks, and CI requirements**

## Synopsis

```bash

```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | no | — | Project directory to analyze (defaults to current directory) |
| `output` | no | terminal | Output format (terminal\|json\|markdown) |
| `dry-run` | no | false | Preview what files will be analyzed without reading them |
